painPoints.title: Slow inventory management processes
painPoints.description: Manual stock-taking and order tracking lead to delays and inaccuracies.

painPoints.title: Error-prone point-of-sale transactions
painPoints.description: Inconsistent data entry and lack of integration cause invoicing mistakes.

painPoints.title: Disconnected customer data sources
painPoints.description: Customer profiles are siloed across POS, CRM, and loyalty systems.

painPoints.title: Repetitive payroll and HR tasks
painPoints.description: Manual employee onboarding, timesheets, and benefits administration are time-consuming.

painPoints.title: Inability to forecast demand accurately
painPoints.description: Lack of data integration and analytics prevents optimized ordering and stocking.

painPoints.title: Fragmented supplier communication and orders
painPoints.description: Placing and tracking orders across multiple suppliers is complex and inefficient.

painPoints.title: Compliance issues with sales tax reporting
painPoints.description: Manual tax calculations and filings lead to errors and penalties.

painPoints.title: High returns processing overhead
painPoints.description: Unstructured returns workflows create delays, data gaps, and customer dissatisfaction.

painPoints.title: Lack of integrated marketing analytics
painPoints.description: Campaign performance data is scattered across platforms, hindering data-driven decision-making.

painPoints.title: Inefficient employee scheduling and shifts
painPoints.description: Manual shift planning and time-off requests lead to over/understaffing issues.
